page: OVHcloud r3-256 is a memory-optimized server instance designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute resources. Powered by an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor, the instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 2.3 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The hardware configuration features 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is supported by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is established with an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the r3-256 demonstrates strong multi-core and memory performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 4744.5 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 135.71 GB/sec. Database operations and key-value store performance are notable, with Redis SET operations achieving 75.95 million operations per second. Single-core performance, such as Geekbench single-core and gzip compression, falls within the average range.

The resource density of this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound deployments by eliminating hyperthreading overhead and providing dedicated physical cores. This architecture makes the r3-256 highly suitable for memory-intensive databases, Redis caching layers, large-scale data compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
